def regexr_transform(column):
    # Standardize the spelling of the HospitalOwner column
    pattern = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z]+_-_[A-Za-z]+')
    return column.str.replace(pattern, lambda x: x.group(0).replace('_', ' '))

# Apply the standardization function to the HospitalOwner column
df['HospitalOwner'] = regexr_transform(df['HospitalOwner'])

# Filter for hospitals located in cities with at least three different hospital ownership types
unique_ownership = df['HospitalOwner'].str.split().str[0].value_counts()
hospitals_with_three_types = unique_ownership[unique_ownership >= 3].index

# Filter the DataFrame based on the hospitals with at least three different hospital ownership types
result = df[df['HospitalOwner'].str.contains('|'.join(hospitals_with_three_types))]
return value
